**Requirement ids:** **SIG-ENG-045** (cited; owner P34.24a — the clone
rehearsal is the production-shaped proof) · **cited:** SIG-STORE-041
(sqitch-managed migrations) · **Base:** `r11/P34.25-api-honesty-code`
(stacked; merge after #226) · **Ticket:**
`docs/tickets/230_P34.24b__sqitch-l44-52-clone-rehearsal.md` (manifest
row 230 — Round 11 / P34, sub-round 11A) · **Live stage:** read-only
(`sig-pg`) + clone — the PITR clone rehearsal was **OM-20

## Why

Before anyone deploys `db/sqitch.plan` L44–52 to production, P34.46's
go/no-go needs measured numbers: the `ACCESS EXCLUSIVE` hold on
`claim_evidence`, total duration, temporary disk and index builds — on
a point-in-time clone of `sig-pg`, for the exact plan tip, without
touching `sig-pg` or any plan line.

## What this ships

**The harness (committed, dry-run by default).**

- `ops/src/ops/sqitch_rehearsal.py` — the `sig.sqitch-rehearsal/1`
  record builder: read-only snapshot SQL (sqitch.changes tip, relation
  sizes, `pg_stat_database` incl. temp counters, `pg_database_size`),
  a SELECT-only lock/index sampler over `pg_locks` +
  `pg_stat_progress_create_index` writing JSONL, timestamped
  deploy-log parsing (per-change seconds, revert rows, split-line
  completions), lock-episode grouping with honest bounds (observed
  window + 2×interval; unmeasured is `null`, never a fabricated zero),
  plan/L44–52 sha256 with a byte-identity assertion (C-10).
- `sig-ops sqitch-rehearsal {snapshot|sample|record|plan-hashes}` —
  additive CLI verbs; **DSN via `SIG_REHEARSAL_DSN` env only, never
  argv**; `--instance` refuses `sig-pg` and every name outside the
  drill shapes (exit 42, greppable).
- `ops/gcp/restore-drill.sh --apply rehearse --clone-name
  sig-pg-drill-l44-<stamp>` — the live leg through P34.6's proven path:
  name-check → proxies → source pre-read → head read → background
  sampler → `docker run sqitch/sqitch@sha256:f247ab0e…` with
  `PGOPTIONS=-c lock_timeout=1200000` and `db/` mounted read-only →
  `sqitch verify` → post-reads → record written **even on deploy
  failure**. `--check` is plan-only (no ADC/network/Docker mutation).
  `DRILL_INSTANCE_RE` accepts the `-l44-` name shape; `deleteclone`
  refuses `sig-pg` unchanged.

**The rehearsal (executed, pre-authorised).** Two PITR clones of
`sig-pg` were created, rehearsed, measured and name-check-deleted;
`sig-pg` was read-only throughout (all write-counter deltas zero;
operations list shows only the clone pairs). Both records and the
committed summary are in
`docs/build/reports/p34.24b-l44-52-rehearsal/REHEARSAL.md`; raw
artifacts under `docs/build/logs/restore-drill/drill-*/rehearsal/`.

## The live result — a real deploy blocker, recorded not smoothed

**`sqitch deploy --verify` to the plan tip cannot currently complete
on the production-shaped instance** — reproduced identically on two
independent clones: six L44–52 changes deploy+verify `ok`, then
`verify/intake_storage.sql:80`'s `SET LOCAL ROLE sig_intake_receiver`
fails (`permission denied to set role`) — Cloud SQL `sig` is not a
superuser and holds no membership in the deploy-created `NOLOGIN` role
(the same `SET ROLE` mechanism sits in
`verify/intake_application_bridge.sql` and
`verify/recovery_apply.sql`; *inference*, never reached). Sqitch
reverted cleanly both times; `sqitch verify` on the reverted head
exits 0. **Deploy exit 2 is the honest result** — P34.46's deploy
cannot succeed until the fix lands; it is owed as **D-P34.24b-1**
(a new appended change, never an in-place edit of L44–52 — C-10).

Measured on attempt 2 (238 lock samples @250 ms, 0 errors, 96
episodes): deploy-to-failure 86.538 s wall; **`claim_evidence`
`ACCESS EXCLUSIVE` max hold 13.344 s observed / ≤ 13.844 s bound**
(the `ALTER TABLE … ADD COLUMN` inside `claim_assertion_bindings`);
temp delta +272.9 MB / 6 files; `claim_evidence` 441→501 MB (+13.6 %,
post-revert dead space); no in-progress index build caught at a
sample instant (honest empty). Six tip changes were never attempted —
the 13.344 s is a measured floor for the attempted prefix, flagged as
such for P34.46 (thresholds: ≤ 20 min and ≤ 2× measured; disk ≥ 2×
the 441 MB table — ample at 15 GB).

Attempt 1 additionally caught two live-only harness defects (the
`pg_locks` join compared name to oid — 214/214 samples errored; the
parser missed real `+`/`-`/`ok` shapes) — both fixed forward in this
branch and its record rebuilt with an honest `null` lock headline.

## Safety rails held

- `sig-pg` was never passed to a mutation path — the name check
  runs before any mutation verb; refusal is tested (exit 42, zero
  docker/gcloud mutation invocations).
- `db/sqitch.plan` untouched: `git status` clean; L44–52 sha256
  byte-identical to base in both live records (C-10); the plan was
  mounted `:ro` inside the deploy container.
- Clone deletion ran even though the deploy failed — no `sig-pg-drill-*`
  remains (post-state `gcloud` list at 12:59Z).
- DSNs stayed in env; secrets never written.

## Tests

- `tests/ops/test_sqitch_rehearsal.py` — 51 tests: name
  acceptance/refusal matrix, CLI wiring + env-only DSN, SELECT-only
  SQL assertions (incl. the `a.datid = l.database` join the live leg
  proved necessary), snapshot/record schema, deploy-log parse shapes
  (split `ok`, revert rows, `Deploy failed`), episode grouping +
  bounds, honest-null behaviour when samples never ran **or** all
  errored, plan-hash C-10 freeze (the live span hash is pinned).
- `tests/ops/test_restore_drill_iac.py` / `test_cloudsql_drill.py`
  extended: `--apply` refuses `sig-pg` with zero mutation calls;
  `rehearse --check` prints the planned deploy/verify path; existing
  drill shapes still accepted.
